title: Reading Poetry Closely
text:
Poetry is a form of writing that uses rhythm, rhyme and imagery to express feelings and ideas. Unlike a novel, a poem often says a great deal in very few words. Poets choose each word carefully, because the sound and position of a word can change its meaning. Many readers find that a poem becomes clearer each time they read it.

Some poems follow strict rules, such as a fixed number of lines or a repeated rhyme scheme. Others, called free verse, have no regular pattern at all. Free verse allows poets to match the shape of a poem to the thoughts inside it. Students who read poetry regularly often find that their own writing becomes more precise.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does poetry use to express feelings and ideas?
According to the second paragraph, what is free verse?
options: A poem with a fixed number of lines
A poem with no regular pattern
A poem written without any words

questions.text: Why might a poet choose each word carefully?
options: Because short words are easier to read
Because a word's sound and position can change its meaning
Because poets are not allowed to use long words
Because readers prefer rhyme over meaning

questions.text: What can be inferred about students who read poetry regularly?
options: They will never write their own poems
They may become more precise in their writing
They only read poems with strict rules

paragraph_translations: Şiir, duyguları ve fikirleri ritim, uyak ve imgeler kullanarak ifade eden bir yazı biçimidir. Bir romanın aksine, bir şiir genellikle çok az sözcükle çok şey anlatır. Şairler her sözcüğü dikkatle seçer, çünkü bir sözcüğün sesi ve konumu anlamını değiştirebilir. Birçok okur, şiiri her okuduğunda daha da netleştiğini görür.

Bazı şiirler sabit dize sayısı ya da tekrarlanan bir uyak düzeni gibi katı kurallara uyar. Serbest dize adı verilen diğerlerinde ise hiçbir düzenli kalıp yoktur. Serbest dize, şairlerin şiirin biçimini içindeki düşüncelerle eşleştirmesine olanak tanır. Şiir okumayı düzenli olarak yapan öğrenciler, kendi yazılarının daha kesin hale geldiğini sıklıkla fark eder.
